locations.title: Tachy Mode
locations.description:
Unlocked when you visit the [Tetrapod](#loc=462252) after returning from Matrix 11.

Equip Tachy's memento, Tachyon Blade, to use its powerful skills. Tachy Energy is charged during battle with enemies. Attacking or defeating enemies charges more Tachy Energy.

Note that Beta and Burst Energy does not charge during Tachy Mode. Also, you will be unable to damage the enemy's Balance.
